problem: Tender preflight and document-readiness work for Taiwan SMEs
user: Taiwan SME owner, bid lead or tender specialist

evidence_items.claim_supported: Customer review praises external consultant for completing a service proposal within a limited time.
Buyer requests external government proposal writing, staged fees and long-term cooperation.
evidence_items.limitations: scope is writing, not the proposed light preflight

evidence_items.claim_supported: Paid roles include tender data collection, reading tender specs, bid meetings, presentation, formatting and data integration.
evidence_items.limitations: internal labor does not prove external purchase

evidence_items.claim_supported: Guide emphasizes checking exclusion conditions, contract risks and qualification requirements before spending effort.
evidence_items.limitations: educational content may have selection/sales bias

spend_or_labor_evidence: external proposal service requests and buyer review

recurrence_and_leverage.standardizable_unit: qualification matrix, company profile, attachment/version checklist and red-flag report
recurrence_and_leverage.leverage_path: reusable profiles/templates, vertical rules and delegated QA

contradictory_evidence: observed market may prefer full proposal writing
expert trust and credentials may be decisive
research_gaps: separate preflight from writing in offer
